messages:
nina: Quick poll 1: who wants a tiny office tailgate for the big game this Sunday? Burgers + bets? :hamburger: :stadium:

omar: I'm in for burgers. Betting? How about $5 and loser brings buns next week?

kelly: $5 sounds perfect. Can we do a mini prop sheet? Longest field goal, first turnover, final score margin.

ben: I will absolutely bet on longest field goal and then be emotionally devastated. Count me in.

nina: OK props: (1) longest FG >40 yards (2) first TO (interception/fumble) player name (3) winning margin >7. 2 points each correct, 1 bonus point for predicting both first quarter TD and final winner.

omar: Sounds fair. Who's cooking?

kelly: I can bring a small grill and patties, but we need a table. Facilities ok to borrow a picnic table from floor 3?

calendar-bot: Event created: "Office tailgate + mini-prop pool" 2026-02-15 16:00 PT. Reminders at 2h and 30m prior. Invited: nina, omar, kelly, ben.

ben: I'll Venmo $5 to nina. Also someone make a quick sign-up for dietary prefs? Veggie burgers?

nina: Added a tiny form: https://forms.office/mini-tailgate (veggie option included). Please RSVP by Friday noon.

omar: Can we also have a halftime cornhole showdown? Loser washes grill.

kelly: Very on brand. Ben you better practice.

ben: Practice makes perfect. But I am naturally gifted at dropping chips.

nina: Final note: keep it respectful, no loud cheering past building quiet hours, and clean-up shared. See y'all Sunday! :tada:
